test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Many people like playing cricket, but _____________ my opinion, it is too chaotic.
solution:
The correct answer is** "in"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Here let's see the whole sentence:

__
 
• Many people like playing cricket, but **in **my opinion, it is too chaotic.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's understand why the given word is used:

 
• In general,** in** is used to indicate location or position within or inside something

 
 
• 
 
***Eg.*** We went for a swim in the lake.
